steps.description:
Let's summarise what you have learnt so far.


These are the input sensors and output modules that you have learnt.

     


You've explored how variables can enhance your program's functionality. Now, design a meaningful project that uses them, whether it’s a game or a task-based application. You do not need to use all the different blocks but should try to use more to demonstrate your knowledge.

The project must be logical and purposeful, as you'll later document it in presentation slides. 

Use at least one of the following input sensors:

  • Colour Sensor
  • Ultrasonic Sensor
  • 1 to 3 Buttons

Use at least one of the following output modules:

  • Buzzer
  • LCD
  • Motor

You should NOT 

  • simply copying or lightly modifying existing snippets.
  • use blocks that have not been taught.
  • exceed 500 in total blocks. You can right-click on white space in your coding area to see the count.

Having great ideas is certainly not easy, but you did it before! You can revisit your snippets from past works or look at images for inspiration.

  

Describe your project as shown below using the Comment block. These comments will be added to presentation slides subsequently.


    Title:
       Give your project a title

    About the Project: 
        Briefly describe your project in 1 to 2 sentences.

    How it works: 
        List down the scenario. 
        E.g. when certain button is pressed what happen, 
                when certain distance is sensed what happen, etc.
